concepts.name: What SDM is
concepts.objective: Explain that SDM maintains supplemental data in DDH — the extra attributes downstream apps need that the source systems don't provide, layered onto the imported system-of-record data — and is the human, RACI self-serve editor for the CSSD-curated portion of DDH, where people make the authoritative edits the Sync-* fleet then propagates.
concepts.remediationAngle: Two anchors: (1) 'supplemental' — SDM maintains, in DDH, the attributes the source systems don't provide (plus the sync config); the data lives in DDH, SDM is the editor; (2) RACI self-serve — the data owners edit their own data. Contrast with the mechanical Sync-* fleet that just propagates the result.

concepts.name: How SDM is built (two repos, one app)
concepts.objective: Describe SDM as one deployed web app from two repos: an Angular SPA served at /Iapetus plus an ASP.NET Core 8 backend (REST /api/* and SPA host) over the SchoolObjectModel SQL database via EF Core.
concepts.remediationAngle: Trace a single request: browser asks for /Iapetus (SPA shell) or /api/* (JSON) -> ASP.NET Core backend -> EF Core -> SchoolObjectModel DB.

concepts.name: Authorization via AAD groups
concepts.objective: Explain that SDM authorizes by Entra (AAD) group claims: DA-* groups (maintained by Sync-DDH-AAD) arrive on the OIDC token and decide which menu items and data a user gets; a 403 means a missing DA-* group.
concepts.remediationAngle: Trace one sign-in: Entra OIDC -> group claims -> the menu (management tasks) filtered by the user's DA-* groups -> an API check that returns 200 or 403.

concepts.name: The core domain entities
concepts.objective: Name the main things SDM manages — Schools, Staff (and jobs), the three Data-Owner security groups, Standalone Groups, the org structures (Municipal Divisions, District Programs, Wards, Trustee Positions), and Site Security — and that edits write to DDH with CreatedBy/UpdatedBy audit.
concepts.remediationAngle: Group the nouns: people (Staff, Vendor Reps), org structure (Schools, Municipal Divisions, Wards, District Programs, Trustee Positions), and access (Data Owners, Standalone Groups, Site Security).

concepts.name: Two front ends: the legacy shell and the Iapetus app
concepts.objective: Explain that SDM serves two front ends from one backend — a legacy AngularJS shell that renders the menu/outer page and a newer Angular SPA mounted at /Iapetus — and that each nav link is either an in-app /Iapetus route (upgraded) or a legacy link.
concepts.remediationAngle: Follow a click: the legacy Razor shell (HomeController/IapetusController) renders the page + menu; an 'upgraded' link loads the Angular SPA at /Iapetus/<feature>, while a legacy link stays in the AngularJS shell.

concepts.name: How the menu is built (management tasks)
concepts.objective: Describe how SDM builds each user's menu: their DA-* AAD group claims map (via SQL) to 'management tasks', and a nav link only appears when the user holds the task that grants it — so the menu is per-user.
concepts.remediationAngle: Chain it: DA-* groups -> a stored proc maps groups to management tasks -> NavigationLinkService emits only the links whose task the user holds; the Training link is the exception (always shown, config-driven).

concepts.name: Editing the record: audit and soft-delete
concepts.objective: State that every SDM edit writes to DDH on entities with a GUID Id, CreatedBy/UpdatedBy audit fields, and a soft-delete flag, with an AuditLog row per change — so changes are attributable and reversible, and DDH (not SDM) holds the data.
concepts.remediationAngle: An edit is never a silent overwrite: the entity carries a GUID Id + CreatedBy/UpdatedBy + a soft-delete flag, and an AuditLog row records who/what/when — all in DDH.

concepts.name: Notifications and the temp-job workflow
concepts.objective: Explain that SDM sends email notifications (via the shared Cssd.IT.EmailNotifications / MailKit library) for events like on-hold / temp-job merges — config-driven and disabled in dev — and that this covers HR-gap staffing (temp jobs under six weeks, contractors, vendors) SDM exists to manage.
concepts.remediationAngle: Tie it to purpose: SDM owns the HR-gap staffing (temp jobs under six weeks, contractors, vendors); creating/merging those can fire a config-driven email that is off in dev via DisableEmailNotifications.
